label: ამბავი გრძელდება
about: The Story Continues: a cluster that already had a video and has since gained 2+ outlets and a number or quote the earlier video's articles didn't have. Part N, compared by code against the stored state.
brief: This is the rubric „The Story Continues“: the viewer may have seen the earlier part; tell what is new since then.
The hook says the new development; the first scene after it shows a new number or quote (code lists them below).
One sentence may recall what was already known; everything else is new, and all of it is in the articles.
Never say „as we reported“ or judge how the story developed.
